reason: Wave 2 reaches 91.7 % (log) of wave 1 and three H4 closes are beyond 78.6 %, so EM1 and EM3 drop the setup before any trigger. The only 15M close beyond B (08-17 23:45) has weak volume and fails back.
notes: Wave 1 and wave 2 are the expert's reading (the lower-degree 1-2 of btcusdt-d1-2026-07-long); an earlier reading with wave 1 08-03 08:00 62300 and wave 2 end 08-11 16:00 63238 (70 %) was dropped. It never got a trigger either. EM1: wave 2 retraces 91.7 % (log) of wave 1 by the low (62535.24 on H1 08-14 14:00, H4 candle of 12:00); 78.6 % = 62946. H4 closes beyond it: 62920.78 (08-14 04:00), 62868.83 (08-14 08:00) and 62900.0 (08-16 20:00). EM3 drops the setup with the first one, which closes on 08-14 08:00, before the end of wave 2. Wave 2 on H1 (a possible count): A 65474 -> 63238 (08-11 19:00), B 64500 (08-12 12:00, 57 % of A), C 62535 (08-14 14:00); C/A is 0.89 (log), a good zigzag shape, but it does not help because the depth is out of range. Wave 2 lasted about 4.7 days (08-09 22:00 to 08-14 14:00). Trigger: the first 15M close above B after the end of C is 08-17 23:45 at 64532.1, only 32 above B, volume 1.3x the 20-candle average: a weak break (EM4), no trigger. Price fell back afterwards (see btcusdt-d1-2026-07-long). This move was later traded as the lower-degree 1-2 of the D1 setup (entry 08-18 14:00); that trade is documented there.
